title: Jub
description: Jub The Description says all  Basically the mod is stuff revolving around the word Jub exept 2 mobs.
body:
Basically the mod is Stuff revolving around the word jub Minus 2 entities. The portal to the Juber Dimension is made out of cobblestone. The Juber Dimension Portal ignitor is made out of 8 Dirt and one of my new plants the Jubant And the mod adds 2 new mobs and a new boss which I could not get it to spawn one of so it spawns a lot I added new tools and new armor which the armor does not have a recipe right now but I will add it in the next update and the mod has a new painting a new enchantment a new structure that spawns in the juber dimension and a new biome the Jub biome that is in the juber dimension and a new block and a new liquid.

Also one of the new mobs is a creature that if you know the reference then cool.

I'm so sorry for what you're going to endure.

Also this is my first mod.

Stone pickaxes break the Jubock which is the new blocks name.

I used the word Jub because i think It's a funny word.



Also I originally named the mod Why again Before I changed it to  Jub mod and in Mcreator you can't change the name which is the name before the items and everything in the mod says Why again.



Also the only wood in the dimension will be the structures like my custom one and the plains villages so if you want wood before you enter the dimension then grab as much wood as you would want in the overworld or just leave my dimension and enter the overworld and then go back to my dimension.



Also ruined portals genarate in the Juber Dimension but Nether portals Don't work so if anything those are there for the blocks and loot.
